355473.title: Derangement reciprocal-product congruences
355473.literal_statement:

$$
\sum_{\tau\in D(p-1)}\prod_{j=1}^{p-1}\frac{1}{j-\tau(j)}\equiv\left(\frac{-1}{p}\right)\pmod{p^2}
$$

and

$$
\sum_{\tau\in D(p-1)}\operatorname{sign}(\tau)\prod_{j=1}^{p-1}\frac{1}{j-\tau(j)}\equiv1\pmod{p^2}.
$$

These congruences concern derangement-restricted permanent- and determinant-type sums; the supplied text gives no resolution.

355980.title: Frankl's even-parity conjecture for t-intersecting k-Sperner families
355980.literal_statement:

$$
|{\mathcal F}|\leq\sum_{i=0}^{k-1}\binom{n}{\frac{n+t}{2}+i}.

356665.title: Golomb–Moreno conjecture on circular Costas sequences
356665.literal_statement:
Let $\mathbb{Z}_n$ denote the cyclic group of order $n$. A **circular Costas sequence** is equivalent to an injective map $\varphi:\mathbb{Z}_n\to\mathbb{Z}_{n+1}$ whose difference maps

$$
\Delta_{\varphi,k}:\mathbb{Z}_n\to\mathbb{Z}_{n+1},\qquad i\mapsto\varphi(i+k)-\varphi(i)
$$

are injective for every nonzero $k\in\mathbb{Z}_n$. A Welch sequence is obtained from the Welch construction over a finite field. **Golomb–Moreno's conjecture.** A Costas sequence is circular if and only if it is Welch. Circular Costas sequences form a stronger class than singly periodic sequences, and the conjecture asserts that the Welch construction gives all of them; its resolution is not established in the supplied text.

381788.title: The strong Fox conjecture for alternating knots
381788.literal_statement:

$$
\Delta_K(t)=\sum a_i t^i.
$$
